title: TechScript
tagline: A modern programming language and developer ecosystem built from the ground up in Rust.
description: TechScript is a complete programming language ecosystem featuring a custom Lexer, Parser, AST architecture, Stack-based Bytecode VM, Standard library, and Package manager — all engineered in Rust for maximum performance.
problem: Most modern languages are either overly complex, hard to extend, or lack an integrated developer-first toolchain.
solution: Built from scratch in Rust with a modular Cargo workspace architecture. Features a custom Lexer & Parser producing a strict AST, a Stack-based Bytecode VM, a Standard library, and a Package manager foundation.
features: Custom Lexer & Parser producing strict AST
Future LLVM backend & Language Server (LSP) roadmap
architecture: Lexer → Parser → AST → Bytecode Compiler → Stack VM → Runtime Output
challenges: Designing a type system that balances simplicity with expressiveness
Implementing a stack-based VM from scratch in Rust
Managing Cargo workspace dependencies for 6+ crates
optimizations: Zero-copy string slicing in the Lexer
Bytecode instruction folding for constant expressions

roadmap.title: Core Rust Lexer, Parser & Cargo Workspaces Architecture
TechScript v2.0 AST Generator & Stack Bytecode VM Runtime
Package Manager Foundation (tspkg) & Standard Library Modules
In-Browser WebAssembly Playground & Interactive Sandbox Execution
LLVM IR Emitter & Language Server Protocol (LSP) IDE Server Integration

title: NovOS
tagline: A futuristic web-based desktop operating system with neomorphic window management.
description: NovOS is a full web-based operating system providing a reactive desktop interface, custom window manager, virtual file system, taskbar app launcher, and built-in system app ecosystem in React & TypeScript.
problem: Standard web portfolios feel flat, static, and fail to showcase desktop-grade state management and windowing systems.
solution: Engineered a custom windowing engine with draggable floating viewports, virtual file system, theme customization, and an integrated suite of desktop applications.
features: Custom reactive window manager with maximize/minimize/snap
Virtual File System with folder hierarchy & file previews
Taskbar app launcher & dynamic system tray
architecture: React Desktop Shell → Window Manager → Virtual FS → State Stores → App Renders
challenges: Managing z-index ordering & active window focus states across multiple apps
Implementing smooth 60fps window dragging and resizing performance
Building an in-memory virtual file system with persistent state
optimizations: Virtual DOM window isolation to prevent re-renders
GPU-accelerated transform CSS for window physics

roadmap.title: Reactive Window Manager with Maximize, Snap & Focus Engine

title: Aurora-OS.js
tagline: Extensible web OS game and hacking simulator framework in TypeScript.

solution: Built a modular web OS architecture with a virtual process scheduler, terminal emulator, and custom app registration system.
